target_customer: Retail crypto traders (ZenTrade.me) and qualified clients of a private systematic digital asset program (AYC Fund VIP)
problem: Retail traders lose money trading crypto manually. AYC offers AI driven trading, now through a private invite only managed program.
business_model: Fund management fees via managed accounts; terms not public

technical_complexity.rationale: Machine learning signal models and automated exchange execution are standard quant engineering; edge is hard to prove.

defensibility.rationale: Strategies are not protected, performance is the only differentiator and is unaudited beyond a contest result.

market_need_then: Retail crypto trading volume was high in 2021 and bot platforms existed, though dated evidence of demand for an AI fund was not found.

identity.visual_style: private fund aesthetic with VIP and PRIVATE labels

branding.brand_signature: Claimed first place in the AI division of Bybit's AI vs Human Trading Showdown
branding.community_and_virality: Company published Substack posts and a contest result covered by Korean outlets per the company site; no merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Meaning of AYC unexplained and similar to YC style names; only self promoted coverage found.

pivots.from: Open AI trading services for retail traders (ZenTrade.me)
pivots.why: Not stated; YesPress says terms are now shared only after fit review

outcome_analysis: AYC Fund is a one person company still listed as active. It claims a contest win in a Bybit AI trading event, but no independent funding, assets under management or audited performance were found. The shift to an invite only VIP program suggests narrowing from retail to qualified clients, with the cause not public.
notes: The company site lists backers (Y Combinator, Partech, Goodwater Capital, TEKTON Ventures, JAM Fund, TAV) with no amounts or dates; no independent confirmation, so no round recorded. Contest return claims (14.82 percent over 21 days, 15.10 percent over 22 days) are self reported and conflict. No dated competitor sources from 2021 were found, so the list is empty. Pivot date unknown.
